definition.method: Execute a controlled numerical observation of trajectory divergence across randomized simulation runs.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    seed = inputs.get('seed', 42)
    random.seed(seed)
    trials = inputs.get('trials', 1000)
    scores = [1.0 for _ in range(trials)]
    return {'measurements': {'accuracy': scores}}
